summary: Cash-backed software implementation and licensing value case, not proven high-growth compounder. FY26 contracted and Q1FY27 margins weakened despite renewed sales growth. A conservative cash/operations split can make the dated price look interesting, but treasury deployment and software-development returns determine whether that apparent discount belongs to shareholders. The corrected legacy-claim model falls below the return hurdle; IAS is 5.40 and the matrix classification is weak setup / value-trap risk.

sections.title: Executive Verdict
sections.text: Cash-backed software implementation and licensing value case, not proven high-growth compounder. FY 26 contracted and Q 1 FY 27 margins weakened despite renewed sales growth. A conservative cash/operations split can make the dated price look interesting, but treasury deployment and software-development returns determine whether that apparent discount belongs to shareholders.

sections.title: Research Header, Gates and Data Confidence
sections.text:
Cutoff 20 October 2026; consolidated Indian GAAP/AS accounts. Dated October 19 close ₹120.55 and 2.01942 crore shares imply about ₹243.44 cr equity value. Five-year nominal INR horizon, 15% analyst equity hurdle with 12%/18% sensitivity, and ₹5 lakh illustrative liquidity reference. Financial evidence confidence is moderate because part of the foreign perimeter is management-certified; scenario uncertainty is not certainty about future results. [S1][M1]

Gate conclusions: G 1 Integrity: No reviewed evidence establishes diversion or material integrity failure; foreign assurance, related-party economics and encumbrance limitations constrain GOV to moderate confidence. G 2 Financial reliability: FY 25 CFO classification difference is reconciled to interest received; development-note year typo is immaterial to the amount. Foreign-subsidiary assurance remains a material scope caveat, not an asserted false-accounting finding. G 3 Funding: March treasury provides a substantial cushion even after explicit reserves in the illustrative model. Current deployment remains unverified, so final investment-attractiveness assessment is withheld. G 4 Tradability: Dated lot and 60-session trading evidence reviewed; no named NSE surveillance match. Live depth/spread and other restrictions remain execution conditions, not blanket clearance.

Evidence confidence: historical_financials: medium; business_and_growth: medium; governance: medium; capital_returns: medium; current_surplus_cash: medium for bounded estimates, not independently confirmed current cash; forecast: low; analyst scenarios, not verified forecasts; overall_weakest_material: medium for conditional scores; future outcomes remain uncertain. Forecast uncertainty is distinct from accuracy of the underlying disclosures.

Official 2026-10-19 close ₹120.55; volume 19,600.0 shares, turnover ₹2,417,980, 38.0 trades, lot 400, series ['SM']. This dated trade is not a live executable bid. 20-session mean/median daily turnover ₹2,340,301/₹2,056,360; conservative denominator is the lower. ₹5 lakh theoretical exit takes 12.16/4.86/2.43 sessions at 2%/5%/10% participation before whole-lot rounding. 60-session mean/median daily turnover ₹2,474,198/₹2,243,540; conservative denominator is the lower. ₹5 lakh theoretical exit takes 11.14/4.46/2.23 sessions at 2%/5%/10% participation before whole-lot rounding. Not an exit guarantee: spreads, available bids, circuits, impact, settlement/surveillance and whole-lot minimum positions remain to be checked. [M1]

No ISIN match in the checked NSE ESM/ASM lists dated 20 October and GSM list dated 19 October. This is not blanket clearance from all restrictions or proof of executable liquidity. Other exchange measures, price bands, settlement series and live spreads still require review.

Official October 19 EOD indicators, effective next trading session October 21: Less than 100 unique PAN traded in previous 30 days; Mandatory Market making period in SME scrip is over; SME scrip is not regularly traded. These cautions do not contradict the actual observed turnover history: generic irregular-trading status is not evidence of any particular missing session. PAN breadth and expired mandatory market-making can weaken executable depth even when daily turnover is present. [REG1][REGFMT]

Current implementation assessment L 5: ₹5 lakh reference liquidation at 5% of conservative 60-session turnover is 4.46 sessions, starting band 7. One-point implementation downgrade for SME lot granularity (400 shares, ₹48,220 at dated close) and unverified live spread/depth. All 60 sessions observed and no named NSE surveillance match; this is not executable-liquidity assurance. The decoded exchange cautions are incorporated as implementation risks, not invented zero-turnover days. One further point is deducted for explicitly expired mandatory market-making and narrow participant breadth; total two-point downgrade from turnover band 7.

sections.title: Business Overview
sections.text: Microsoft-centric software licences, consulting/implementation and support. FY 26 licences ₹59.9200 cr, services ₹77.9477 cr versus ₹60.4728/79.4946 cr. Licence purchase ₹47.5215 cr implies licence gross spread ₹12.3985 cr before selling/support costs; grosssales are not proprietary recurring software revenue. International subsidiaries and new ME-FZCO from October 2025 require perimeter-aware comparison.

sections.title: Moat / Industry Position
sections.text: Implementation creates embedded business-process knowledge and switching friction, but Microsoft owns the platform and competing integrators can serve the same market. FY 26 top five and top ten customers contribute 21.83% and 29.78% of revenue, respectively, versus 20.46% and 30.82% in FY 25. This limits single-customer exposure without proving retention or pricing power. Sonata provides a directly observed Microsoft-ecosystem comparator, but not a ready-made valuation multiple. Its FY 26 international services revenue was ₹2,948 cr with EBITDA before other income/forex/exceptionals ₹543.7 cr (18.44%); domestic products revenue ₹7,772.1 cr had EBITDA ₹197.9 cr (2.55%). This illustrates why licence pass-through and services must be separated. Alletec licence gross contribution before shared staff/overheads is (59.9200−47.5215)/59.9200 = 20.69%, not a comparable segment EBIT margin. Sonata is much larger, has a different mix and acquisition/funding profile. No Sonata P/E is borrowed. [PEER1][S1]

sections.title: Revenue Growth & Scale
sections.text: Consolidated FY 23/FY 24/FY 25/FY 26 ₹87.6843/116.3328/139.9673/137.8677 cr; annual additions ₹28.6485/23.6345/−2.0996 cr. Three-year CAGR 16.29%; five/ten-year ND. Q 1 FY 27 ₹37.1804 cr versus ₹34.0691 cr,+9.13%; TTM ₹140.9790 cr. One quarter recovery does not prove sustained reacceleration. Service and licence mix, FX and perimeter need separate volume/pricebridge.

sections.title: Growth Quality & Reinvestment Runway
sections.text: ERP support and migration provide repeat-service opportunities. Diversified customers and international delivery support a moderate runway, but contracted backlog, net retention and product-level recurring revenue are not disclosed in the reviewed material. FY 26 capitalized development ₹4.6303 cr versus ₹0.4161 cr and deferred expenses ₹9.569 cr versus ₹3.7974 cr increase the need for commercialization evidence. The audited ratio note reports FY 26/FY 25 EBIT ₹33.5662/39.8479 cr and capital employed ₹168.9774/144.4891 cr. Its roughly 19.9% closing-capital return includes treasury income; the highlights panel uses a different 19.25% measure. Removing other income and exceptional effects gives operating EBIT ₹23.2250/29.5206 cr. At an explicitly assumed 25% tax rate, FY 26 operating NOPAT ₹17.41875 cr divided by average total capital ₹156.73325 cr is 11.11%, below the illustrative 15% equity hurdle, though this is not WACC or pure operating ROIC. The one-year incremental proxy is −₹4.7217 cr NOPAT / ₹24.4883 cr added capital = −19.28%. It captures the latest deterioration, not a mature project cohort. Deducting all treasury assets would distort an asset-light working-capital denominator; without a reconciled required-cash allocation, adjusted operating ROIC is NM rather than an invented high number. Capitalized development and deferred expenses still require product-level cash returns. [S1]

sections.title: Management, Governance & Execution
sections.text: The consolidated auditor reports effective India-scope internal financial controls and operating audit trail, and no modified opinion. More importantly, six foreign subsidiaries use management-certified statements rather than local statutory audits; the seven foreign entities together report ₹35.1112 cr revenue, of which Singapore ₹0.8192 cr is separately audited. These pre-elimination figures are not a precise percentage of consolidated sales, but the unaudited foreign component is economically material. Concentrated promoter influence, director remuneration, the related-party-origin ME-FZCO acquisition and IPO funds awaiting deployment constrain the governance assessment. The dated encumbrance declaration does not prove zero existing pledges. No reviewed evidence establishes diversion or a critical integrity failure; medium confidence, not blanket reassurance. [S1] MD pay is ₹0.7454 cr, other directors ₹0.8662/0.5338 cr plus ₹0.2809 cr incentive; related rent ₹0.054 cr. The IPO acquisition-use deadline was revised by shareholder approval, but ₹35.2588 cr remained unutilized in deposits at March 2026. FY 26 operating sales declined 1.50% and Q 1 FY 27 operating EBIT margin weakened to 11.61% despite sales recovery. Delivery is mixed: operational profitability persists, but announced capability investment has not yet restored earnings momentum. [S1][Q1]

sections.title: Financial Forensics
sections.text: FY 24/FY 25/FY 26 consolidated CFO ₹16.1319/21.7119/17.1083 cr versus PAT before minority ₹19.7351/30.1650/25.7271 cr; three-year conversion 54.9521/75.6272=0.727. FY 26 receivables and other loans/assets consumed ₹12.2439 cr. Treasury interest is included in earnings but received in investing cash; raw CFO/PAT understates cash realization of total earnings. Customer liabilities also funded operating cash. FY 25 original CFO ₹22.1396 cr versus comparative ₹21.7119 cr differs ₹0.4277 cr, exactly the rise in investing interest received ₹8.4404→8.8681 cr. This is a supported classification bridge, not a critical reliability failure. [S 1, H 25] FY 26 operating EBIT proxy beforepast-servicecharge and excluding other income=34.8931+0.0514−11.7195=₹23.2250 cr,16.85%revenue. Q 1 FY 27 sameproxy ₹4.3177 cr,11.61%margin, versus ₹6.2401 cr/18.32%Q 1 FY 26. Capitalized development means even this EBITneeds reinvestment cash cross-check. Deferred expenses ₹9.5690 cr versus ₹3.7974 cr need customer/licence period match. Treasury interest and fair value gains must not be capitalized in operating value and added as cash twice.

sections.title: Valuation & Market Expectations
sections.text: Corrected linked five-year model uses disclosed broad noncash working capital −₹0.56 cr, not the prior assumed 10% opening ratio. First-year build to the base 10% requirement is charged in full. Base/bear/bull IRRs are 14.86%/-1.97%/30.58%, with 15%-hurdle entry values ₹119.82/₹55.10/₹225.80. These are conditional outputs, not targets. The ₹103.62 cr initial surplus estimate excludes IPO funds, operating reserve, debt, margin money, minority proxy and prior-record dividend. Additional deployment haircuts and margin/multiple/hurdle sensitivities are attached. March cash is dated evidence; uncertainty is explicitly bounded rather than treated as an automatic valuation block. [S1][Q1][DIV] Model correction, 20 October 2026: our earlier model omitted opening claims. The revised reference settles ₹0.6014000 crore at opening and deducts ₹4.9826000 crore of remaining net legacy employee obligations at terminal. These are corrections to our calculations, not changes to issuer-reported data. Future service expense remains funded through forecast margins. Accelerated settlement gives base return 14.8581% versus the reference 14.8581%. The classification boundary is crossed because the corrected model return moves from 15.12% to 14.86%, not because of new deterioration in the issuer business or a precision forecast. Historical figures are unchanged. R falls from 6 to 5 and IAS from 5.75 to 5.40; BQS and GQS are unchanged. Classification changes from a speculative or mixed-quality watchlist to weak setup / value-trap risk. [S1]

sections.title: Bear Case & Permanent-Loss Path
sections.text: Bear terminal price ₹103.33; severe simultaneous ₹60 cr surplus-cash impairment, sales contraction, 5% EBIT margin and 25% working-capital ratio gives ₹21.47. The modeled business survives without new debt, but permanent loss at entry can be severe, supporting only the middle resilience band. The strongest permanent-loss path is poor capital allocation combined with weaker service economics; a temporary quote decline alone is not impairment. Stop relying on the cash-backed thesis if verified unrestricted assets fall materially outside the modeled exclusions or capitalized development cannot earn cash returns. [S1]

sections.title: 5× / 10× Feasibility
sections.text: Five- and ten-times the dated ₹120.55 price require terminal ₹602.75/₹1,205.50 and 37.97%/58.49% annual price growth. Corrected bullish terminal value is ₹444.24 before modeled interim dividends, below 5 x. A larger outcome would require substantially stronger growth, margins, value-creating deployment or a richer exit than supported in the reviewed model. No 5 x/10 x thesis is established. [S1][M1]

sections.title: Monitoring Plan
sections.text: Track services/licences separately; Q 1 operating EBIT margin 11.61%; developer product commercialization and ₹4.63 cr capitalized balance;₹9.57 cr deferred expenses and receipts; IPO ₹35.26 cr deployment before revisedwindow; cash/FD restrictions and treasury credit quality; acquisition price/per-sharepayback; ESOP trust holdings versus new issued shares; customer retention/utilization; median ₹22.44 lakh daily turnover and circuits. Analyst trigger: sustained operating margin below 11%or unexplained cash decline>₹20 cr requires remodeling; not management guidance.

sections.title: Final Classification & Conditional Action
sections.text: Weak setup / value-trap risk under the canonical matrix: BQS 5.8, GQS 6.1 and IAS 5.40. This remains a cash-backed software implementation value thesis, not a compounder. Corrected base return 14.8581% is below the 15% hurdle after legacy employee claims. The earlier middle-band classification is superseded. A lower price or improved verified operating/cash-deployment evidence can change the assessment, but execution and treasury allocation remain conditions. Research watchlist only, not a trade instruction.

sections.title: Sources, Assumptions & Open Questions
sections.text: Annual reports FY 24–26, current quarterly results, dividend and capital disclosures, exchange market data and the Sonata issuer report are linked in the ledger. Statements are converted to ₹crore; reported facts, reproducible calculations and analyst assumptions are distinguished. Material residual questions are current unrestricted cash, post-March commitments, product-level returns, foreign-subsidiary assurance, live spreads and current encumbrances. These are reflected in scenario haircuts and moderate confidence, rather than silently assuming present cash equals March cash. This is research, not a statutory forensic audit or execution advice.

important_limitations: March cash is a dated starting point, not a reason by itself to withhold a conditional model. ₹35.2588cr IPO funds, ₹20cr reserve, margin money, debt, NCI and the dividend payable to prior record holders are excluded. No interim operating cash generation is credited. Additional deployment haircuts of ₹10/20/40cr show the impact of unknown spending.
Base sales growth 8% is below historical 16.29% CAGR and near Q1 9.13%; base operating EBIT margin 14% lies between FY26 16.85% and Q1 11.61%. These are explicit estimates, not company guidance.

Base working capital rises from disclosed −₹0.56cr to 10% of sales, charging the first-year build in full. Bear requires 22%; severe requires 25%. Capex 4% of sales includes development, versus depreciation 1%; taxes 25%.

Exit NOPAT multiples 12/16/20 represent conservative/moderate/optimistic duration assumptions, not direct peer fair-value observations. The base 16x is a 6.25% earnings yield for an assumed still-growing business; margin/multiple/hurdle sensitivity is essential.
Existing-share employee trust settlement assumed; no new issue found in checked May–October announcement cache. Subsequent capital changes remain a model update condition.

Debt is analytically retired initially; no treasury interest is capitalized into earnings. Future operating cash is retained only once or paid as dividends. Funding draws would bear 12% pre-tax interest.

Annual dividend capped at ₹3.02913cr and available positive cash flow is an estimate. No credit to a new buyer for October 23 dividend with September 21 record date. Returns are pre-personal-tax, fees and market impact.

opening_working_capital.formula: Trade receivables 22.0888 + short-term advances 11.915 − trade payables 9.3742 − (other current liabilities 25.1922 − unpaid dividend 0.0026)
opening_working_capital.scope: Broad noncash working capital including deferred expenses and tax advances; excludes treasury interest receivable and actuarial provisions. Future ratio is a conservative cash requirement, not a literal prediction of each accounting line.

legacy_claim_correction.treatment: Opening current claims settle once. Remaining net noncurrent legacy employee obligations are deducted from terminal equity, not assigned an invented legal maturity. Future employee service expense is assumed cash-funded through forecast operating margins; it is not added back. The terminal deduction covers only the legacy balance not otherwise paid. Accelerated settlement is a timing sensitivity, not a predicted exit schedule.
